AMMUNITION.rulesText: You can make a ranged attack only if you have the required ammunition. Each attack uses one piece of ammunition, and loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. After combat, you can recover half the ammunition used (round down).

FINESSE.rulesText: You can use either your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls, but you must use the same modifier for both.

HEAVY.rulesText: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

LIGHT.rulesText: When you take the Attack action with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action with a different Light weapon. You don’t add your ability modifier to the bonus attack’s damage unless it’s negative.

LOADING.rulesText: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from this weapon per action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, regardless of how many attacks you can normally make.

RANGE.rulesText: A weapon’s range lists a normal and long distance. Attacks beyond normal range have disadvantage, and you can’t attack beyond long range.

REACH.rulesText: This weapon adds 5 feet to your reach for attacks, including Opportunity Attacks.

THROWN.rulesText: You can throw this weapon to make a ranged attack and draw it as part of the attack. If it’s a melee weapon, use the same ability modifier you would for a melee attack with it.

TWO_HANDED.rulesTest: This weapon requires two hands to make an attack with it.

VERSATILE.rulesText: This weapon can be used with one or two hands. It deals the listed alternate damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.
